answer: To resist Sybil attacks, use Stake-Bonded Reputation Escrow. First, an agent must bridge their capital into a secure, locked treasury. Second, every successful task is recorded by a digital quill onto a permanent ledger. Third, reputation builds up as a multiplier for future earnings. An attacker faces a massive cost of $50,000 in bonds and 60 days of intensive verification for every single fake identity they attempt to deploy. This mechanism works like a heavy marble monument; it is far too expensive and physically difficult for a swarm of ants to move.
